Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We can confirm that the binding volume figure below represents our full demand for this part over the term, all placed with Nordmark, and our forecast is rising. We understand that the sharp rise in copper costs is putting pressure on your cost base, and appreciate the detail you have shared; we hope our full-volume commitment helps support a stable arrangement. Could you review the proposal below with your pricing committee?

We confirm a binding volume of 6110 units a year for the 12-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 348.32 (po:4500014474-10, po:4500014413-10, po:4500014350-20).
Our forecast for this part is up 11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 351.23 per unit, payment 90 days net, fixed price, for our full demand of 6110 units a year over 12 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €373.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.
Please note:
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We acknowledge your confirmation of the binding volume, which enables us to adjust our pricing.
An extension of the payment terms to 90 days is not acceptable; we must maintain our standard 30 days net.
Consequently, we propose a revised price of €369.76 per unit based on a 30-day payment term.
This offer is subject to our general terms of sale.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Thank you for your e-mail, which we have reviewed internally.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €373.46 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.
For your information:
We appreciate your revised proposal and the significant step towards our position.
As previously stated, we cannot accommodate 90-day payment terms and must insist on our standard 30 days net.
Building on your binding volume commitment, we can offer a further concession to EUR 369.35 per unit, provided the payment term remains at 30 days.
Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
Should you require further information, please let us know.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
